description: Steam Bridge is a network proxy mod for Minecraft that uses Steam P2P and SDR for connections. It lets you play with friends without port forwarding or public IPs, ensuring minimal latency, high stability, and secure transport directly through Valve's gaming infrastructure

mods.name: Steam Bridge
mods.description:
Steam Bridge - play Minecraft with friends without a public IP.

Players connect via SteamID over P2P or Steam relay - no port-forwarding needed, works behind NAT.
If a direct connection is not possible, traffic is automatically routed through Steam relay servers.

Requires Steam (AppID 480 - Spacewar) to be running.

releases.notes:
## Added
- Linux x64 support via an optional runtime addon (`steambridge-linux-runtime-<mc range>`). Natives are SHA-256 pinned, extracted to `~/.cache/steambridge/native/`, `steam_api` is loaded before `steamworks4j`.
- NeoForge 26.1 / 26.2 / 26.3 support: one jar, a separate internal adapter per version, a new Java 25 Panama (FFM) backend with Windows and Linux ABI profiles.
- Steam invites from session management, accept joins automatically.
- `iceEnabled` setting: `false` skips ICE and forces Valve relays.
- Bounded per-peer queues (256 KB / 250 ms) for reliable traffic.

## Fixed
- Cracked guests got kicked on join when the host had a licensed session (1.12.2): `getCurrentServerData()` was null, so auth always hit the failure path.
- Same-name guest could grab the host's GameProfile and kick the host on Forge 1.19.2. Now uses the shared login mixin, `sameNameAsHost` works.
- Join Server button stayed grey after picking a friend on 1.7.10 / 1.8.9 / 1.12.2: the hook enabled button id 1 instead of id 0.
- Cheats toggle on Open via Steam got reset by vanilla re-reading `level.dat` (1.12.2).
- Steam tag in the server list showed even with Steam closed.
- NPE on 1.7.10 / 1.8.9 guests: the voice proxy started with no voice driver installed.
- SVC voice reader could hang forever on reconnect (socket switched to Steam mode between channel open and selector creation).
- Game thread froze when Steam networking stalled: listen socket setup moved to a dedicated native thread with a 5 s timeout, connection close is now async.

## Changed
- Whole codebase moved from branch-per-version to one multiloader monorepo (`core`, `runtime`, `transport-netty`, `steam-jna`, `steam-panama`, `adapters/*`). Shared code compiles into every adapter jar.
- Single `config/steambridge.json` for all versions. Old `.toml` / `.cfg` configs get migrated.
- Routine logs moved to DEBUG, repeated errors throttled to once per 30 s.
- Release jars are reproducible (fixed timestamps and entry order after ForgeGradle reobf).

## Removed
- Fabric 1.16.5.
